Industry Leading Warranty. Read More Request Service → Swimming Pool Leak Detection Services : Fast Effective Testing Procedures Upon arriving at your pool our skilled technicians will plug and pressure test all plumbing lines to find underground plumbing leaks. If a leak is found, we will pin-point it using acoustic leak detection equipment for accurate location of the broken plumbing. Our technician will also perform a full dye test of the pool structure, checking for cracks or voids in the plaster; as well as performing a comprehensive analysis of the pool equipment pad. The process takes on average 3 hours. After we have successfully located your leak, you will be provided a full report, which will include an estimate for your Leak Repair if required. Industry Leading Warranty We offer an industry leading 90 day warranty on our Leak detection services; as well as a 2 year warranty on any plumbing or fixtures installed underground. This warranty is our commitment to you, ensuring that your satisfaction and peace of mind are our top priorities. We stand by our work, and honor our warranty as soon as possible. If, after service, your pool continues losing water, or a new leak arises in the span of the defined period, contact us. We will immediately schedule a return visit at our earliest available time slot. Competitive Pricing Our competitive prices reflect not only the quality of our work but also our commitment to providing value for your money. We use efficient repair methods and high-quality materials to ensure that your pool is fixed right the first time, saving you money in the long run. We understand that every pool and budget is different. That’s why we offer personalized quotes that match the specific needs of your pool and your financial considerations. Our goal is to provide you with the best possible service at the most reasonable price. Family Owned Our family-owned business treats every pool repair as if it were our own. The values that hold our family together—honesty, hard work, and reliability—are the foundation of our service. When we repair pools, we’re not just fixing cracks and pipes; we’re restoring the heart of your backyard oasis. We strive to build a relationship with every client, ensuring transparency and communication throughout the repair process. We understand that each pool has its own story and needs. That’s why we offer customized repair solutions that address the unique challenges of your pool. Our family’s personal touch means we’re attentive to the details that matter most to you. Read more → Cosmetic Repairs From epoxy patching to complete masonry replacement, Manly Maids’ cosmetic pool repairs restore your pool’s appearance and integrity.
